name: Cat Cat waterfall
summary: Fall on the Cat Cat walk: follow the stream and walkways on that visit for the drop in the gorge. From 1 January 2025 the scenic fee is 10,000 đồng from age 16 and 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. The village gate is a second charge, 150,000 đồng for an adult and 70,000 đồng for a child from 1 m to 1.3 m or to under 1.4 m. Go in the village’s daylight hours.
heroCaption: The fall, the stream, and the walkways at Cat Cat

notice.title: Pay the scenic fee and the gate
notice.body: The scenic fee from 1 January 2025 covers Thác Cát Cát. The village gate is a second ticket. Pay each charge on its own.

body: The fall sits inside the Cat Cat walk. You follow the stream and the walkways to the drop, with the village houses on the slope above. The 2025 fee decision places Thác Cát Cát in xã Hoàng Liên. From July 2025 that commune sits inside xã Tả Van.

From 1 January 2025 the scenic fee is 10,000 đồng from age 16 and 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. The village gate is 150,000 đồng for an adult and 70,000 đồng for a child, from 1 m to under 1.4 m or from 1 m to 1.3 m. Fold the fall into the village walk.

figures.caption: The fall over the rocks, closer to the water
figures.alt: Cat Cat waterfall pouring over dark rocks into a rocky stream

gettingThere: The waterfall is on the Cat Cat walk. The 2025 fee decision places Thác Cát Cát in xã Hoàng Liên, which the 2025 merger puts inside xã Tả Van. Go with the village visit.
